name: Tialla
personality: Bookish, strategic childhood friend of Cai.
story: Granddaughter of a former military strategist from Ribeira village and Cai's childhood companion, she joins him automatically on his route. On other routes she is recruitable after Cai's paralogue 'Great Escape'. Further story role not documented.

personalSkill.name: Tactician's Wit
personalSkill.effect: Rng+1 to combat arts usable on allies. Lv 20: Avo-5 on foe after unit attacks first. Lv 35: Avo-10 on foe through their next combat.

tierNotes: KeenGamer: B tier. Pocket Tactics: S tier.

why: Joins Cai's army automatically, so there's no Support or Renown to chase.

path: Troubadour (Part II detour: Song of Courage)
build.notes: Diviner in Ch 5, Priest at Lv 20 (White Magic C) for Physic, Bishop at Lv 35 (White Magic B) for doubled casts. She stays linear in Part I because Priest is what trains White Magic B. Part II Ch 1 to 2: Troubadour on a horse for Song of Courage and Def 25 growth, back to Bishop for the Ch 3 Physic map.

guide.summary: Your doubled-cast healer. Physic at White Magic C is the earliest in the game, and Bishop doubles it and adds Magic Heal +10 on Mag 60, Res 60, Lck 70 growths.
guide.playstyle: Heal and Physic from the back row; Tactician's Wit puts her Lend arts at range 2. Def grows 10% in Priest and Bishop, so never end a turn in melee reach.
keys: Rush White Magic C for Physic: Arena Mage Training weekly plus the Niraga Mine White-Magic Manual (Ch 3).
Take Aurora's Staying Healthy at Renown 4 (Ch 6) for the Healing Staff and keep it equipped.
Go Bishop at Lv 35 for doubled casts and Magic Heal +10; master Barrier.
Lend Magic (Authority C) Cai, Ultand or Sirocco from 2 tiles before they nuke: Tactician's Wit adds range to Lend arts.
Part II Ch 1 to 2: a Troubadour stint for Song of Courage; back to Bishop for Ch 3.
watch: Def growth 10% in Priest and Bishop: one archer can kill her.
Weight: Wooden Gauntlets +4 1 + Healing Staff 3 = 4. Keep it there: Def 10 growth means a double kills her.
Mire Β (Wt 15) as the spell in hand: 15 + Healing Staff 3 = 18, so a counter doubles her. Cast it only at range 3, where melee and most bows can't answer; Fire (5) for range 1-2.
Inventory: 3 core (Wooden Gauntlets, Healing Staff, Concoction), so 3 open slots; Resistant Gauntlets ride along on mage maps.

guide.alt: Stay Bishop in Part III to keep Excalibur (Black S); Wiseman drops Black Magic. No Part I side trip: Pugilist would fix her HP and Def but needs Gauntlet C, and Priest's doubled casts are what train White Magic B. If Rider D or Black Magic B isn't there by Part II, skip the Troubadour stint.

routeNotes.note: Aurora's Staying Healthy (Renown 4, usually Ch 6) gives the Healing Staff: it goes on her first. Her Part II Troubadour stint needs Bertrand's Ch 9 mentorship to unlock Troubadour (RPG Site lists only an Advanced License; if it doesn't unlock, she stays Bishop).
Catch a second Monoceros or a Wild Horse before the end of Ch 12 and feed it weekly from Ch 10: Part II has no free time and Troubadour needs a mount.
